items.title: Car trouble eng.
items.author: hvtuo
items.body:
We are a family from Finland travelling on holiday with two small children. Unfortunately, the belt tensioner (serpentine belt tensioner) on our Mercedes-Benz Sprinter W906 with an OM651 engine has broken, and we are now stranded in Tromsø.

We sincerely hope that someone here might be able to help us or give us some advice. If anyone knows where we could find a new or used tensioner, or knows someone who could help us, it would mean a great deal to us.

We are very grateful for any help or suggestions. We truly hope we can find a solution and continue our journey.

Thank you very much in advance for any help.

Kind regards,

Iikka Siira

+358 44 552 2937

Edit: just to clarify if anyone has or knows someone who might have the right part new or used we would love to buy it as we know how to change it ourselfs.
